'''Pandor's Hydrospanner''' was a repair and provision facility located in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. It was part of the chain of [[Pandor's Hydrospanner]]s that stretched across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The store was run by a modified [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] called [[D-3P8]] and carried a wide selection of goods, including weapons, survival gear and mining equipment.<ref name="Game" />

Pandor's Hydrospanner also dealt in vehicles. It leased several [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] that held its selection of [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|snubfighters]]. In addition, Pandor's would sell and install upgrades for their customers' vehicles. However, they strictly followed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] laws and would report any illegal modifications.<ref name="Game" />
